principles.claim: Continuous repository evolution must be evaluated over repeated iterations.
Regression control is a first-class objective, not a side effect.
Executable feedback and repository context are central to self-evolution.
principles.operationalization: tests, contracts, trajectories and evidence ledger

principles.claim: Behavioral success alone can be insufficient to prove intended structural change.
Scaffolding and harness changes can alter observed agent behavior.
principles.operationalization: hold evaluation conditions stable and record harness version

promotionPolicy: Research informs hypotheses; experiments generate evidence; independent verification controls promotion.
